AC3 A non-DDGSException from the delegated client (e.g. httpx.ConnectError) also returns the branch-2 sentinel and does not propagate; oracle: unit test whose fake client raises it.
AC4 Both branches conform to DuckDuckGoResult; oracle: TypeAdapter(list[DuckDuckGoResult]).validate_python.

AC10 The sentinel gets no authority beyond reporting prior art UNVERIFIED, and results stay untrusted; oracle: existing T1 rubric test plus new assertions.
AC11 The rubric states a zero-result search means prior art UNVERIFIED rather than absent and cannot alone support a no-prior-art conclusion; oracle: rubric unit test.
AC12 ADR 0063 records that re-argument; oracle: the ADR diff.

AC14 Tests use no live network; oracle: fake DDGS subclasses only, no ddgs network client constructed.
AC15 The change is portable and in-process, needing no CI provider; oracle: inspection shows only local Python and unit tests.

findings.detail: The criterion requires a targeted pytest transcript showing red-before/green-after behavior. The ticket comment references .rebar/scratch/impl91af-cd818479/red-targeted-pytest.log and final-targeted-pytest.log, but the .rebar/scratch directory is not present in the repository (list_directory of .rebar shows no scratch subdirectory, and a search attempt returned an error). This is a codebase-verifiable criterion (no [non-codebase] tag), so the ticket comment attestation alone is insufficient. No pytest transcript is accessible in the repository.
findings.remediation: Add the pytest transcript files to the repository (e.g. under .rebar/scratch/impl91af-cd818479/ or docs/), or tag this criterion [non-codebase] and record a ticket comment with the specific transcript output (commit ref, test run timestamp, and pass/fail counts).
findings.title: Red/green pytest transcript not present in repository

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: use the evidence path that matches each one. For codebase-verifiable work, complete any unfinished work and make its proof discoverable in the repository. For evidence that inherently lives outside the repository, mark the criterion with the exact `[non-codebase]` tag and add a comment to this ticket that documents the concrete artifacts that meet it (commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the evidence to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so properly tagged evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. An untagged external criterion cannot be satisfied by a ticket comment alone. Then re-verify. Note that a finding reporting a ticket record as absent means it was NOT VISIBLE IN THE TICKET SNAPSHOT THE VERIFIER READ — that snapshot is pinned when the run starts, so a record written after the pin, or not yet committed to the store, reads as missing even though it exists; re-verify after the write lands rather than re-recording evidence you already wrote.
